snippet.title: to a T | Switch 2 Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
to a T is a narrative adventure game about Teen, a teenager who is in the shape of a T. Available on  PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and now Nintendo Switch 2!  Enjoy a new trailer with the Giraffe Song, a song recorded by Rebecca Sugar.
https://annapurnainteractive.com/games/to-a-t

Developed by uvula. Published by Annapurna Interactive. © Annapurna Interactive, 2026
